task.title: One-way Backlog.md to GitHub Project sync (tools/backlog-sync)
task.description: We moved tracking to Backlog.md, but the owner wants to see work on GitHub, and Backlog.md's own cross-branch view is limited: task list/view read only the current checkout, and backlog board lets the current checkout's copy win, so an In Progress task in another worktree still shows as To Do on main. A small local sync gives a GitHub Project that reflects the real state of every worktree on this machine, while keeping Backlog.md the single source of truth. GitHub stays read-only except for one narrow inbox path for proposing new tasks. Target: users/djensenius/projects/8.

nodes.title: One-way Backlog.md to GitHub Project sync (tools/backlog-sync)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reads task state through the backlog CLI across all local worktrees and picks the most recently updated copy of each task
Creates or updates one issue per task, matched by a hidden <!-- backlog:task-N --> marker plus a 'task-N:' title prefix
Sets the Project Status field via GraphQL; Done closes the issue and reopening a task reopens it
Idempotent (a second run changes nothing) with a --dry-run flag
Inbox: open issues labelled 'inbox' become new To Do tasks (create only), then the label is removed and the marker added
launchd plist and install steps are documented, and logs go to a file
Go unit tests cover resolution, rendering, marker matching, diffing and inbox import without network access

ArkhamHorror multi-repo placement maps Backlog project values to configured issue repos, searches all configured repos for existing markers, refuses all GitHub reads/writes outside the allowlist, and never duplicates issues when a task moves repos.
Nested task IDs such as TASK-1.2.7 normalize consistently for markers, title prefixes, branch ownership and matching.
Referenced GitHub issues can be adopted behind adoptReferencedIssues without adopting pull requests, mismatched repos, or issues carrying a different marker.
Managed-label sync supports exact/prefix/* allowlists, addAlways, priority labels, case-insensitive comparison, missing-label creation, and never touches the inbox label or unmanaged labels.
Optional extra Project fields for priority, milestone title, area, task ID and branch are updated only when configured and safe, with absent fields/options handled without data loss.
Configured sub-issues link child issues under parent issues when needed and warn once on unsupported cross-repo linking.

Inbox import scans every configured repo, guards against existing references before creating tasks, writes only from a clean main worktree, removes inbox labels, marks imported issues, and pushes main only when configured.
One binary works for multiple config files with per-config launchd install and per-config locking so independent configs can run side by side.

task.implementationPlan:
1. Add a standard-library-only Go module under tools/backlog-sync with CLI flag parsing, timestamped logging, subprocess adapters for gh/backlog/git, cross-worktree task collection and deterministic task resolution.
2. Implement issue body rendering, strict marker matching, REST issue/label diffing, project-v2 GraphQL status synchronization, dry-run/no-op behavior, and guarded inbox import through backlog task create.
3. Add unit tests with fakes for resolution, rendering, marker parsing, diff/idempotency, issue state/project status changes, inbox import/guards, and empty-main abort safety.
4. Add README and launchd plist documenting flags, cross-branch behavior, build/install/operation, and log file paths.
5. Validate with go vet, go test, go build, and one read-only dry run; then update Backlog task evidence without marking coordinator-only real-run/install evidence complete.

6. Fix review blockers and correctness/test gaps, generalize configuration for reuse in other repos, validate with tests/build/vet plus one read-only dry run, then leave task-16 In Progress for coordinator real-run evidence.

7. Generalize backlog-sync around JSON configuration, multi-repo allowlists, task-prefix normalization, managed labels/fields/sub-issues/inbox behavior, per-config locking and launchd install, then validate with unit tests/build/vet and read-only dry runs only.

Round 3: fix claimed-issue ownership across markers/inbox/adoption, sub-issue allowlist parent handling, cfg.TaskPrefix-derived parsing, dry-run field reporting/zero-write guards, and review should-fix items; then add targeted fake/parser/fixture tests and validate with vet, tests, build, and both read-only dry runs.
